faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Bhubaneswar Library Professional Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Library Professional Trainee post at IIT Bhubaneswar is 31 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Library Professional Trainee posts?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Library Professional Trainee post in the IIT Bhubaneswar recruitment drive. Interested candidates should check the official notification for detailed information.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for IIT Bhubaneswar Library Professional Trainee?
faq.answer: The application mode for the IIT Bhubaneswar Library Professional Trainee recruitment is Online. Candidates need to visit the official website and fill out the application form electronically.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Library Professional Trainee?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Library Professional Trainee post is 26 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC, ST, PD, and OBC categories as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for a Library Professional Trainee at IIT Bhubaneswar?
faq.answer: The selected Library Professional Trainee will receive a consolidated salary of ₹23,000/- per month. This is a contractual position at IIT Bhubaneswar.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualifications for the Library Professional Trainee post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a First Class in Masters in Library and Information Science or an equivalent degree from a recognized Institute/University with a good academic record to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIT Bhubaneswar Library Professional Trainee recruitment. Applicants can apply free of cost.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Library Professional Trainee?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Library Professional Trainee post at IIT Bhubaneswar includes a Written Test followed by an Interview. Candidates must perform well in both stages to be considered for selection.
